name: Kreativ Link Audit and Editorial Suggestions
description: Audit internal content links, find orphaned posts, and review suggestions for useful connections.
cardMeta: Internal link auditing and editorial suggestions.
cardUse: Find orphaned content and review potential links before adding them.
imageAlt: Kreativ Link Audit and Editorial Suggestions thumbnail
metaDescription: Audit internal links and review editorial link suggestions in WordPress with Kreativ Link Audit and Editorial Suggestions.

detailItems.title: Audit your content
detailItems.body: Run a resumable scan of stored published posts, pages, and enabled public post types. Review orphaned content, weak links, and a searchable link explorer.

detailItems.title: Find relevant opportunities
detailItems.body: Suggestions are generated locally using title, category, tag, and keyword overlap. Review each suggestion in context.

detailItems.title: Stay in control
detailItems.body: Preview a proposed insertion before confirming it. Undo supported insertions while preserving later edits elsewhere in the content.

ctaLines: Version 1.0.3 has been submitted to the WordPress.org Plugin Directory and is awaiting review.
The plugin is not yet available in the directory.

items.title: Local analysis
items.body: Analysis runs on your WordPress installation. No external service, account, tracking, or paid upgrade is required.

items.title: Editorial review
items.body: Scans do not change content. Adding a link requires an authorized editor to preview and confirm the change.
